technical.summary: Strong trend structure (ADX 41, MACD crossover, three white soldiers) with rising RSI momentum, but price remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CPT shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 35 days create near-term volatility risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absence of congressional buying and unavailable news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (374.4), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and negative macro score (-4) create severely unfavourable conditions; real estate sector faces credit stress and demand headwinds; earnings in 35 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX 41 + MACD crossover + three white soldiers show strong trend structure with rising momentum, and extreme fear (14/100) presents classic contrarian entry opportunity near support at 111.80.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below EMA-21/SMA-21 and Ichimoku cloud with zero fundamental support, earnings volatility in 35 days, VIX crisis (374.4), unfavourable macro (-4), and no institutional/insider conviction make this a high-risk fade into fear rather than a conviction entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure (ADX 41, MACD crossover, three white soldiers) shows trend strength, and extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian opportunity. However, price remains trapped below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with zero fundamental support, earnings volatility in 35 days, and macro crisis conditions (VIX 374.4, unfavourable environment) create asymmetric downside risk.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment combined with earnings event in 35 days and price rejection below moving average confluence creates high probability of mean reversion lower before any swing target is reached.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical strength insufficient to overcome fundamental void, macro headwinds, and event risk
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 15 Real Estate positions and existing CPT position; sector concentration and ticker overlap reduce conviction further and argue against new entry.
